get.description:
One of the scopes: 

- altinn:broker.read 

- altinn:broker.write 

Date filtering behavior: 

- If `status` is included, `from` and `to` filter on when the file transfer changed to that status. 

- If `status` is not included, `from` and `to` filter on file transfer `created` time. 

Result is limited to 100 files. If your query returns more than 100 files, only the 100 newest in the active timeline are returned.

post.description:
Creates a TUS upload resource for an initialized file transfer.

Single-file upload: send Upload-Length only. Continue uploading with PATCH and HEAD on this same URL.

Concatenation partial: send Upload-Concat: partial and Upload-Length for each file segment. The response Location is /broker/api/v1/filetransfer/upload/tus/{fileTransferId}/partial/{partialUploadId}.

Concatenation final: after all partials are complete, send Upload-Concat: final;<partial-location-1> <partial-location-2> ... using the Location URLs from partial creates. Do not send Upload-Length on the final request. Upload-Defer-Length is not supported.

One of the scopes:
- altinn:broker.write

Requires the Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0 header on every request except OPTIONS.

parameters.name: fileTransferId
parameters.description: The file transfer id returned from initialize.

parameters.name: Tus-Resumable
parameters.description: TUS protocol version. Must be 1.0.0.

parameters.name: Upload-Length
parameters.description: Total upload size in bytes. Required for single-file and partial uploads. Omit on final concatenation requests.

parameters.name: Upload-Concat
parameters.description: Concatenation mode. Use <c>partial</c> when creating a segment upload, or <c>final;<partial-location-1> <partial-location-2> ...</c> to finalize.
